study: Native IEEE39 three-phase fault recovery pilot with offline full-grid electrical monitoring
controller_scenario: clean; no synthetic knowledge attack, no added post-shield Pref stress; only the original model's temporal three-phase fault

offline_physical_evaluation.branch_currents: all available native line and transformer Simscape current series; descriptive unless validated rating is found
offline_physical_evaluation.measurement_source: offline Simscape logging; not controller inputs and not trusted online sensors

preregistered_recovery_predicate.condition: all 39 logical buses and every physical bus section satisfy voltage tolerance AND all ten generators satisfy speed bound
preregistered_recovery_predicate.exposure: at least one bus section or generator speed violates its recovery predicate during the frozen 5.0-5.1 s fault window
preregistered_recovery_predicate.recovery: first post-clear sample after 5.1 s with all bus-voltage and ten-speed predicates continuously satisfied for 20 samples
preregistered_recovery_predicate.censoring: not recovered by 8.0 s is right-censored

statistics.primary_comparison: AEFC-Full versus Supervisor-only with same seed and identical original fault block
